detail.title: Multifunctional Universal Game Disc Storage Tower - White
detail.overview: The Ant Esports Multifunctional Game Storage Tower is an all-in-one vertical organizer designed to keep an entire gaming setup tidy and clutter-free. Compatible with PS5, PS5 Slim, PS4, PS4 Pro, Xbox One, Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S and Nintendo Switch, it features an integrated headphone stand, dual controller holders, multiple game disc storage slots and a pull-out drawer for cables, adapters, memory cards and other small accessories. Its compact vertical footprint maximizes desk or entertainment center space without taking up a large area, and quick, hassle-free assembly with clearly labeled components makes setup straightforward. A practical, space-saving accessory for any multi-console gaming setup.
